title: When will FDA announce Reclassification of BPC-157 to Category 1 of the Bulk Drug Substances List? Before November
rules: If the FDA announces Reclassification of BPC-157 to Category 1 of the Bulk Drug Substances List before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The Payout Criterion is satisfied by placement of BPC-157 in either Category 1 or Category 1 Bulk Drug Substances Under Evaluation on the 503A Bulk Drug Substances list, as either designation restores compounding eligibility. 
Removal from Category 2 alone, without placement in Category 1, does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

blind.reasoning: BPC-157 left Category 2 in April 2026 only because its nominations were withdrawn. It has not been placed in Category 1, and as of about October 7 the FDA had taken no final action after the July advisory vote, which went against its own staff's advice. The FDA could quickly add a substance back to Category 1, as it did for GHK-Cu, but nothing suggests it will do so for BPC-157 in the roughly two weeks before November 1.
blind.falsifier: The FDA updates its 503A categories list or issues a notice before Nov 1, 2026 placing BPC-157 (free base or acetate) in Category 1 or 'Category 1 under evaluation.'

final.reasoning: The 11.5% midpoint is above my estimate. The FDA has taken no action toward Category 1 since July, and too little time remains for a placement to be likely. I nudged up slightly from 6% because my research couldn't cover the last few days.
